If you are sick or cannot make the first workshop for whatever reason, please reach out to our Adult Librarian, Lisa Hoang, at 626.444.9506 or LHoang@library.lacounty.gov. LEARNING OUTLINE (subject to change) Week 1: Introduction to Nib Calligraphy, Faux Calligraphy (Pencil and Pen), "Modern Calligraphy, " Tools of the Trade Week 2: Basic Strokes Week 3: Basics Strokes continued Week 4: Lowercase Letters Week 5: Uppercase Letters Week 6: Add some style Week 7: Add some bounce Week 8: Putting it all together.
